svg.title: Notification optimization benefit
svg.desc: Median goodput across 14 measurements per size and mode; whiskers are observed ranges. Mode 1 suppresses reservation wakes. Mode 2 also separates poll and gates blocking commit wakes. Mode 2/reference gains are 1.25, 1.79, and 2.20 times. Lines only connect measured sizes.
